title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series

messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from you again. For this work, we can offer a price of €36.00 per unit. We have our CNC machines ready and look forward to putting this job onto the shop floor for you. 

Let me know if this works for you so we can get started soon.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: RFQ pump shaft HX – request for an improved package
messages.body:
Dear Mr Dralveck,

Thank you for your quote and for confirming free capacity. We value you as a partner, but your price is currently not competitive.

A current rival offer stands at EUR 31.50 per unit with 45 days payment and 42 days lead time (offer:70240-1-a). The energy-related index PPI-D351 fell from 137.0 in 2025-08 to 131.9 in 2026-08, a change of -3.72%.

We propose the complete packages attached, covering 4,200 pc a year over 24 months. Could you also share a rough cost breakdown and any cheaper process or material variants you see?

Kind regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: RFQ pump shaft HX – request for an improved package
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

As to the rival quote data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. Thanks for the clear numbers on the rival offer; I respect good data, so I've sharpened my pencil and can offer €30.50 for the 28-day lead time. Our offer is a price of €30.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. My guys will look into technical tweaks, but we don't share internal cost breakdowns. Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 1.10 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.82 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.51 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: HX pump shaft – complete packages for final review
messages.body:
Dear Mr Dralveck,

Thank you for the improved offer and for the variant savings. We are glad you are taking another look at price.

We would like to award this 24-month volume of 4,200 pc a year to you. To close, we propose the attached complete packages. They balance price against payment terms, and you may choose whichever suits your cash flow best.

When reviewing your costing, it may be worth checking your current material and energy prices against today's market rather than earlier peak levels.

If one of these packages works for you, please confirm it as your primary standing offer.

Kind regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: HX pump shaft – complete packages for final review
messages.body:
Hallo,

Moin, I checked the material and energy prices as you suggested, and you are right that they have come down. We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. Please send over the exact market figures you are looking at so we can compare notes. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. We can accept your terms and await your order.

Our offer stands at a price of €29.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We can do the 42 days lead time you asked for, but 90 days payment is just too long for us to give a discount. We really hope to build a great partnership with you!

Our offer is a price of €32.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net, we can offer a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days. We are super eager to work together!

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.
